description: The integer power base^exp. 2^10 is 1024, and (-2)^5 is -32. 0^0 is 1. exp runs from 0 to 256. The base has at most 80 digits. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ipow
